article_title: Is India's internet boom running into an undersea problem?

tasks.prompt: What is the central argument of the article?
options: India's internet traffic no longer depends on physical infrastructure
India's rapid digital growth is exposing weaknesses in geographically concentrated, ageing cables and limited repair capacity
Submarine cables carry only a small share of international communications
Mumbai has already eliminated every cable-related risk
tasks.correct_answer: India's rapid digital growth is exposing weaknesses in geographically concentrated, ageing cables and limited repair capacity
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה טוענת שהצמיחה הדיגיטלית המהירה של הודו נשענת על תשתית כבלים מרוכזת ושברירית, עם יכולת תיקון מוגבלת.

tasks.prompt: What is concentrated along six kilometres of Mumbai's Versova coast?
options: All of India's data centres
Thirteen of India's eighteen intercontinental submarine cables
Every global cable-repair ship
India's five southern landing cities
tasks.correct_answer: Thirteen of India's eighteen intercontinental submarine cables
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפחות 13 מתוך 18 הכבלים הבין־יבשתיים של הודו מגיעים לחוף בתוך מקטע של שישה קילומטרים בוורסובה.

tasks.prompt: What repair-capacity problem does India face?
options: It has no domestic subsea cable-repair ships and relies on foreign vessels and permits
Its repair ships can operate only in Mumbai
It has banned foreign vessels from Indian waters permanently
It repairs every fault using data centres
tasks.correct_answer: It has no domestic subsea cable-repair ships and relies on foreign vessels and permits
tasks.explanation_hebrew: להודו אין אוניות מקומיות לתיקון כבלים תת־ימיים, ולכן היא תלויה באוניות זרות ובתהליך רישוי ממושך.

tasks.prompt: Why could even a small increase in data-travel time be costly?
options: It would automatically erase every internet account
It would end all broadband subscriptions
It would prevent optical fibres from carrying light
Banks, exchanges, clouds, government systems and AI depend on fast, high-volume connections
tasks.correct_answer: Banks, exchanges, clouds, government systems and AI depend on fast, high-volume connections
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מערכות פיננסיות, ענן, ממשל ובינה מלאכותית רגישות לעיכובים משום שהן תלויות בהעברת נתונים מהירה ובהיקפים גדולים.

tasks.prompt: What does “geographic concentration” mean in the article?
options: Too much critical infrastructure located in the same small area
Internet users moving from villages to cities
Data being stored in a single computer
Repair ships travelling long distances
tasks.correct_answer: Too much critical infrastructure located in the same small area
tasks.explanation_hebrew: geographic concentration פירושו ריכוז של תשתיות חיוניות באזור קטן, כך שאירוע אחד עלול לפגוע בכמה מהן.

tasks.prompt: What does “the real bottleneck” mean in the discussion of repairs?
options: The widest section of a cable
A deliberate attack on a ship
The limiting factor that slows recovery—foreign repair dependence and regulatory delays
A system that reroutes all traffic instantly
tasks.correct_answer: The limiting factor that slows recovery—foreign repair dependence and regulatory delays
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bottleneck הוא צוואר בקבוק: הגורם המגביל שמעכב את התהליך, כאן תלות בתיקון זר ובהיתרים.

tasks.prompt: Use the figures in the article to explain the mismatch between India's data demand and cable infrastructure.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש לפחות בארבעה נתונים מספריים מדויקים ולהסביר את משמעותם.
expected_points: India had more than one billion broadband subscribers by late 2025
It consumes roughly 20% of global data
It is connected to only about 3% of the world's submarine cables
It has 21 cable landing stations compared with roughly 1,900 globally
At least 13 of 18 intercontinental cables land close together in Mumbai
Those cables carry as much as 95% of India's westward international bandwidth
Eleven of 18 international cables are more than 20 years old
Data-centre capacity rose from 375MW in 2020 to about 1,575MW

tasks.prompt: Why is rerouting traffic useful but insufficient as a resilience strategy?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את יתרון הניתוב החלופי ואת המגבלות הנותרות בתחום ביצועים ותיקון.
expected_points: Traffic can be diverted through Chennai, Kochi or other landing points
A cable cut would not necessarily cause a total blackout
Rerouting can still degrade performance and increase latency
Sensitive financial and AI services may suffer from even small delays
Physical faults still require repair
India lacks domestic repair ships
Foreign vessels must travel from Dubai or Singapore
Licensing adds weeks to an already lengthy process
Several simultaneous cuts near Mumbai could overwhelm alternatives

tasks.prompt: Summarise the main vulnerabilities in India's submarine-cable system and the remedies proposed by experts.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול ריכוז גאוגרפי, גיל הכבלים, תיקונים, ביקוש, ממשל והפתרונות המוצעים.
expected_points: Most westward bandwidth is concentrated near Mumbai
Many cables are approaching their nominal operating life
Cable faults are common and often caused by fishing, anchors, hazards or equipment failure
India depends on foreign repair ships
Numerous agencies and about 50 clearances can delay action
AI and data-centre growth may outpace new cable capacity
Experts propose more geographically diverse landing stations
They call for a single-window approval system
India needs domestic repair capability and protected cable zones
Distributed Acoustic Sensing could help detect threats
New cable systems with diverse landings are beginning to be built

tasks.prompt: Write a policy briefing prioritising three actions India should take to strengthen international connectivity.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית מסמך מנומק, לבחור שלוש פעולות ולבסס כל אחת בראיות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Reduce concentration by pre-approving landing sites on both coasts and islands
Create a single-window system led by the telecommunications department
Build or secure domestic cable-repair capability
Introduce faster emergency repair permits
Protect cable routes from anchoring and trawling
Use sensing technology to detect nearby threats
Accelerate new capacity to match AI and data-centre demand
Mention the Mumbai concentration or ageing-cable evidence
Explain trade-offs and implementation time
Avoid claiming any single action eliminates all risk
